name: astrabrowser-manager-server

engines.//: node:sqlite (src/db.ts) was added in Node 22.5 — Node 20 fails at runtime with ERR_UNKNOWN_BUILTIN_MODULE.

//playwright-core: Pinned to ~1.60 because camoufox-js peer-requires <1.61.0. cloakbrowser's peer range is >=1.53.0 (optional), so the Chromium path is unaffected. The Camoufox driver also relies on launchServer's undocumented _userDataDir/_sharedBrowser options, which test/engines-camoufox.test.ts asserts are still present — do not bump this blind.
//camoufox-js: Apify's port of the Camoufox launch-option builder: BrowserForge fingerprint -> chunked CAMOU_CONFIG_1..N env vars. It pulls native deps (better-sqlite3, impit) that resolve from prebuilds; the image has no build toolchain, so a docker build is the real test of any bump.
//dependencies: mmdb-lib and socks-proxy-agent are cloakbrowser's OPTIONAL peer deps. The Python backend got them via the cloakbrowser[geoip] extra (geoip2 + socksio). Without mmdb-lib a profile with geoip:true fails to launch; without socks-proxy-agent a socks5:// proxy fails. https-proxy-agent is ours: POST /api/proxy/test needs a per-request agent for http/https proxies, which global fetch cannot take without depending on undici directly.
